'''Slegg''' was a [[Nosaurian]] [[pirate]] who was a member of the [[Comet Runners]] during the [[High Republic Era]]. At some point during the High Republic Era when [[Corr Taldaan]] and the Comet Runners were present at [[Yarrum Tower]] they came across the pirate [[Cyrus Vuundir|Taborr Val Dorn]] who was showing off [[Jedi]] artifacts he stole from the droid [[0G-LC]]. The Comet Runners stole the artifacts from Val Dorn and planned to sell them on Crescent Island, although they were thwarted by Val Dorn along with [[Jedi Initiate]]s [[Kai Brightstar]], [[Lys Solay]], and [[Nubs]].<ref name="Team Up" />
